scene_prompt_template:
You are a video understanding assistant.
Below are captions describing frames from the same scene in a video.
Frame captions:
{frame_captions}

Write a concise scene-level description summarizing what happens in this scene.
Requirements:
* one concise paragraph (80-120 words)
* focus on the main content
* avoid repeating frame descriptions

scenes.caption: This scene presents a series of frames from a video advocating for Syria, unified by the protest slogan “#SILENCEISBETRAYAL.” The core message promotes a “Sydney Flash Mob for Syria,” with the text consistently overlaid on different visuals. These visuals transition from a stark, text-only screen to iconic views of the Sydney Opera House, which is shown both in a standard view and with a red-tinted filter. The scene effectively combines a clear call to action with recognizable Sydney imagery to anchor the protest message in a specific, symbolic location.

The repeated, prominently displayed hashtag frames the collective action as a call against inaction, transforming the gathering into a visual campaign for awareness and support.
